sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.
sections.changelog:
2.5.1 — Dashboard Quick Actions Layout optimization

  • Dashboard Quick Actions: Refined layout grid spacing, full-width responsiveness, and padding alignment.
  • Mobile Layout Streamlining: Replaced cluttered card views with flat, Notion-style task list rows and clear chronological headers.
  • iOS-Style Bottom Drawer: Re-engineered the task details drawer to slide up from the bottom on mobile viewports.
